messages.sourceEnglish: Compare a fixed US station’s weather observations with clear dates and missing readings.
messages.text: Qhathanisa okubonwe yisiteshi sezulu esingaguquki sase-US nezinsuku ezicacile kanye nokufundwa okushodayo.

messages.sourceEnglish: Review a public US weather station
Choose United States, then load the fixed public station example. Observation and retrieval times stay separate; this does not supply farm weather or planting advice.
messages.text: Khetha i-United States, bese ulayisha isibonelo sesiteshi somphakathi esingaguquki. Izikhathi zokubuka kanye nezokulanda zihlala zihlukene; lokhu akunikezi isimo sezulu sasepulazini noma iseluleko sokutshala.
